answer: PrefixWarden, a registry check, lets only identities holding their own RIR-allocated /24 and a live BGP announcement earn. Its rule, AnnounceCollapse, voids both accounts and slashes their 40-unit bonds when two announce from one ASN, sit inside one /22, or share 90% of routes for 24 hours. At $9,000 per transferred /24 plus $550 per ASN and a two-week registry queue, 20 fakes cost about $191,000 and months of waiting: the ledge to the nectar is priced per fake. An honest agent pays once; a sybil pays full price each time, its fakes willows from one root.
